headline: Bitcoin climbed to about $84,700, its highest since 7 Oct, as Tesla reported a $288M paper gain on its bitcoin and a new US stablecoin rule drew fire from banks.

market.asOf: 21 Oct, 18:34 UTC (01:34 Bangkok) · Bitcoin Foundation news. ETH, SOL and Fear & Greed could not be read this run.

stories.title: Bitcoin climbs to about $84,700, its highest level since 7 Oct
stories.summary: Bitcoin pushed through $84,000 during the US trading day on Wednesday as US stocks rose. Traders who had bet on a fall were forced to buy back, which added to the move. Price swings had been near their smallest of 2026 ahead of the Fed decision on 28 Oct.
points: Bitcoin was about $84,710 at 18:34 UTC, up 2.7% over 24 hours, with a day high of $84,726, per Bitcoin Foundation news (read at that time; live prices are at the top of the page).
Cointelegraph says this was Bitcoin's first visit to around $84,600 since 7 Oct, and that bets against Bitcoin worth nearly $110M were forced closed over four hours.
Over 24 hours, Bitcoin.com counted $243.04M of forced closures (liquidations) across 71,223 traders; $188.14M (77.4%) were bets on a fall.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $526.7M on 19 Oct and $23.2M on 20 Oct, per Farside. The 21 Oct figure was not yet posted.
Bitcoin's 28-day realized volatility is near its lowest of 2026, per K33 data reported by The Block.

stories.title: Tesla reports results with a $288M paper gain on its bitcoin, a day after Musk floated a SpaceX merger
stories.summary: Tesla published its third-quarter results after Wednesday's US close. Its profit included a $288M gain on paper from the rise in value of the bitcoin it holds. On Tuesday, Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla had set up committees to study a merger; together they hold 30,221 BTC.
points: Revenue was $28.05B, flat from a year ago and in line with the $28.06B Wall Street expected, per Electrek.
Adjusted earnings were $0.48 a share against a $0.45 consensus. Profit under standard accounting (GAAP) fell 43% to $787M.
That profit included a $288M unrealized gain on Tesla's bitcoin holdings, meaning a gain on paper that has not been sold.
CoinDesk reported holdings of 18,712 BTC at SpaceX and 11,509 BTC at Tesla. Musk said the committees "have not reached agreement on the terms of any transaction."

stories.title: The first US stablecoin rule under the GENIUS Act is final, and banks are pushing back
stories.summary: The OCC, a federal bank regulator, finalized the first rule putting the GENIUS Act stablecoin law into practice. It sets requirements for stablecoin issuers it oversees. The American Bankers Association attacked it for leaving room for crypto platforms to pay rewards on stablecoins.
points: The OCC's rule (news release 2026-92, 21 Oct) takes effect on 18 Jan 2027. The OCC will announce separately when it starts accepting applications.
Issuers may not pay interest directly. The final rule dropped a proposed presumption against third-party arrangements, so rewards offered by platforms will be judged case by case, per The Block.
ABA CEO Rob Nichols said the rule goes against "Congress's clear intent to protect local lending." The Blockchain Association praised it.

briefs.title: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade is live
briefs.summary: It switched on at slot 459,653,000 around 14:00 UTC and cut the time for transactions to become final from about 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds, per developer Anza.

briefs.title: Zcash sets its NU7 upgrade for about 5 Nov
briefs.summary: Developers agreed on block 3,543,405. The upgrade cuts block times from 75 to 25 seconds.

briefs.title: Grayscale lets investors pay into 10 crypto funds with tokens
briefs.summary: Eligible investors can swap tokens such as BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE directly for fund shares (in-kind subscriptions).

briefs.title: Standard Chartered agrees to buy all of Zodia Custody
briefs.summary: The bank signed definitive agreements for 100% of the crypto custody firm, subject to regulatory approval.

briefs.title: Ether ETFs log a fifth straight day of outflows
briefs.summary: US spot Ether ETFs lost a net $26.1M on 20 Oct, about $388.9M over the five days, per FinanceFeeds citing Farside.

briefs.title: Utah sues prediction market Kalshi
briefs.summary: The state attorney general says Kalshi is illegal gambling. Kalshi says it is regulated by the CFTC and answers to federal law.

briefs.title: Comments close on the SEC's proposed crypto offering rule
briefs.summary: The comment period for the proposed Regulation Crypto Assets ended on 20 Oct. It is still only a proposal.

briefs.title: Survey finds strong interest in Robinhood single-stock perpetual futures
briefs.summary: Mizuho said 94% of 600+ Robinhood users surveyed would trade them. Robinhood has not announced single-stock perpetuals.
